subject: Temporary procurement exception request — Novatech pilot (committee vote)
messages:
From: Alan Chen <alan.chen@novatech.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Novatech Finance <finance@novatech.io>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Novatech is excited to move forward with the two-week integration pilot for the EdgeConnect adapter. To make the kickoff tight (engineers are aligned next week), our finance team is asking whether Redwood can accept invoices for pilot costs without a formal PO for a temporary period, while we complete our internal supplier setup.

We understand this is outside standard process. Proposed guardrails from our side:
- Single invoice <= $15k for pilot scope
- Payment within 30 days of invoice
- Redwood to receive a signed short SOW (attached)

If Redwood needs an internal form or committee sign-off from Novatech, we can get that fast. Can you advise next steps and whether an exception is possible?

Attaching the SOW draft.

Best,
Alan
Alan Chen
Head of Procurement, Novatech Inc.

Attachments: novatech-sow-draft.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Novatech's ask. Quick summary: pilot invoice ~$12k, one-time, sales wants to start next week. Novatech will sign SOW; finance prefers to finish supplier form but can’t before kickoff.

Questions for procurement committee:
1) Are we okay with a one-off invoice-only acceptance for this pilot capped at $15k with a signed SOW?
2) What minimal evidence do we need from Novatech (W-9 equivalent, copy of signed SOW, legal entity verification)?
3) Who must approve for exceptions at this value (committee vs manager)?

I think this is low risk for revenue and important for momentum. Priyom, can you pull the risk notes for similar pilots (edge pilots) and suggest a short checklist we can present to the committee? Neha — please flag anything from compliance side.

-JW
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

On Wed, Jun 25, 2028 at 11:03 AM jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Novatech's ask. Quick summary: pilot invoice ~$12k, one-time, sales wants to start next week. Novatech will sign SOW; finance prefers to finish supplier form but can’t before kickoff.

Agree low risk. From procurement perspective, for a temporary invoice-only path I recommend the following minimal intake (can be captured in a one-page packet):
- Completed PO-exception form (I attached a templated form)
- Copy of signed SOW (must include scope and billing cadence)
- Finance contact + PO contact (we need a named approver at Novatech)
- Proof of entity (simple business registry link)
- Risk note: flag if vendor is in blacklist jurisdictions (Novatech is US-registered — ok)

If the committee approves, I suggest a 30-day retroactive approval window (i.e., allow invoice now, but supplier setup required within 30 days or future invoices blocked).

I attached the PO-exception-form.docx and a short precedent note (PROC-712) for similar approvals. We can present this Thursday at 10:00 for the procurement exception committee.

-Priyom
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: po-exception-form.docx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Thanks everyone — summary and decision ask below.

Summary: Novatech requests a one-time invoice-only process for an integration pilot (estimate $12k). Novatech will sign SOW now; supplier form completion expected within 21 days. Sales requests pilot start next week.

Procurement recommendation (vote requested):
- Approve temporary invoice-only acceptance limited to this single invoice <= $15k.
- Condition approval on: signed SOW on file, completed PO-exception form, named Novatech finance approver, and entity verification link.
- Require supplier onboarding to be finished within 30 days or future invoices paused.

If committee approves I'll: 1) execute the exception form, 2) notify Novatech finance and legal to route the invoice to AP, and 3) put a 30-day onboarding task in JIRA (PROC-712).

Alan — if that works, please send the completed exception form and the signed SoW today so we can proceed. If AP needs anything else, loop them in.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Jonas Weber: Vote recorded — APPROVE (in-thread).
Priyom Das: Vote recorded — APPROVE (pending receipt of completed form).
